body.cms-home .main-container { padding-top: 0 }
.cms-index-index .products-grid :is(.ratings, .actions),
.cms-index-noroute .products-grid :is(.ratings, .actions) { display: none }
.marquee { margin: 2.5rem 0; overflow: hidden; mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 8%, black 92%, transparent) }
.marquee-track { display: flex; width: max-content; align-items: center; animation: marquee 45s linear infinite }
.marquee-track > * { margin: 0; flex-shrink: 0 }
.marquee:hover .marquee-track { animation-play-state: paused }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .marquee-track { animation: none } }
@keyframes marquee { to { transform: translateX(-50%) } }
</style>

.hub { max-width: 80rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem 3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2rem; color: var(--color-base-content, #1c2126); } .hub-top { display: flex; justify-content: center; } .hub-top img { height: 2.5rem; width: auto; } .hub-hero { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; aspect-ratio: 2560 / 1100; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-box, 1rem); background: #cfd6d9; } .hub-hero img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .hub-hero p { position: relative; max-width: 40rem; margin: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-box, 1rem); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.5; text-wrap: pretty; } .hub-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(13rem, 1fr)); gap: 0.875rem; } .hub-card { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--radius-box, 1rem); background: var(--color-base-200, #f6f6f5); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.15s; } .hub-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .hub-card img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .hub-card-name { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; padding: 3rem 1.125rem 1rem; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(255,255,255,0.96) 45%, rgba(255,255,255,0)); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--store); } .hub-note { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #8a9299; } @media (max-width: 40rem) { .hub-hero { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; } .hub-hero p { margin: 1rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; font-size: 1rem; } }
